% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpScreen[src=/docs/components/screen/examples/responsive.html]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/screen/screen.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-screen");
element1.setAttribute("src", "/docs/components/screen/examples/responsive.html");
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}
